cases.input: A boundary changes from operational control to equity share.
cases.expect: A successor revision and base-year recalculation preserve the prior boundary and bridge attribution differences.
cases.violates: A consolidation-method change creates a successor revision.

cases.input: One activity set supports location- and market-based calculations.
cases.expect: Both results pin the same boundary revision and remain non-additive.
cases.violates: Location- and market-based results are non-additive.

cases.input: A successor boundary excludes one sold site.
cases.expect: The structural change triggers recalculation and comparability review.
cases.violates: Structural change triggers recalculation and comparability review.

cases.input: Organizational, operational and value-chain boundaries are stored as one undifferentiated scope.
cases.expect: The boundary is rejected because the facets have different semantics.
cases.violates: Organizational, operational and value-chain boundaries remain separate facets.

cases.input: Uncovered supplier activity is counted as zero.
cases.expect: The result is rejected because missing coverage is unknown.
cases.violates: Missing boundary coverage is never inferred as zero.

cases.input: One source interval maps twice to Scope 1 in the same axis.
cases.expect: The run is rejected for within-boundary double counting.
cases.violates: Each source, asset and interval maps once per boundary and reporting axis.

cases.input: A new consolidation approach overwrites the prior boundary revision.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; a successor and bridge are required.
cases.violates: A consolidation-method change creates a successor revision.

cases.input: Value-chain category 11 coverage rises from 40 to 70 percent with no entity or source change.
cases.expect: Only the value-chain facet revision increments; organizational and operational facet revision identities are unchanged; a new composite boundary revision pins the new value-chain facet and the unchanged other two.
cases.violates: A composite boundary revision pins exactly one revision of each facet, and a facet revision changes only when that facet changes.

cases.input: A switch from financial control to equity share increments the value-chain and operational facet revision identities although neither facet changed.
cases.expect: The revision is rejected because facet versions are coupled.
cases.violates: A composite boundary revision pins exactly one revision of each facet, and a facet revision changes only when that facet changes.

cases.input: An organizational facet revision declares consolidationApproach as proportionalConsolidation.
cases.expect: The revision is rejected because the value is outside the closed set of equity share, financial control and operational control.
cases.violates: Every enumerated field is a closed set; an unrecognised value blocks the run rather than passing through.

cases.input: A joint-venture partner states it reports 45 percent of a shared boiler.
cases.expect: The statement is stored as a counterparty assertion with assertedByOrgRef, assertedShare, consolidationApproach, assertionStatus unverified and evidenceRef, and is not used as an input to any result quantity.
cases.violates: A counterparty assertion is never an input to a result quantity.

cases.input: A partner's asserted 45 percent share is used directly as the apportionment driver in a run.
cases.expect: The run is rejected because an unverified counterparty assertion was consumed as fact.
cases.violates: A counterparty assertion is never an input to a result quantity.

cases.input: Three participants under operational control declare shares of 0.5, 0.45 and 0.2 on one shared asset.
cases.expect: The apportionment is rejected because shares under one consolidation approach total 1.15.
cases.violates: Shared-asset shares held under one consolidation approach sum to at most 1.0, and any shortfall is exposed as a declared residual.

cases.input: A boundary revision reaches effective status with baseYear set to notEstablished.
cases.expect: The transition is rejected because notEstablished is a draft-only sentinel.
cases.violates: A boundary revision whose status is approved or effective carries an established base year and a recalculation policy reference.

cases.input: The candidate references WM-ORG-012 for group context while no approved relation edge exists.
cases.expect: The reference carries edgeState unapproved, a matching hold is recorded, and nothing depends on traversing it.
cases.violates: No approved relation edge exists for any reference in this candidate; all reference edges are declared unapproved.

cases.input: The consolidation approach is resolved by traversing the group hierarchy in WM-ORG-012 rather than read from the organizational facet revision.
cases.expect: The resolution is rejected because consolidation approach is a dated boundary-scoped decision.
cases.violates: consolidationApproach is a dated decision carried on the organizational facet revision and is never derived by traversing an organization or group master.
